title: Magnetic device for gripping and clamping workpieces

features.item: A housing containing a displaceable magnet and pole shoes with workpiece contact surfaces.
features.quote: A magnetic device for gripping and clamping workpieces, in particular sheet-steel elements (L), comprises a supporting casing ( 2 ), slidably mounted within which is a magnet-holder member ( 4 ) carrying a main permanent magnet (M).
features.note: The reference discloses a supporting casing (housing) containing a slidably mounted magnet-holder member (displaceable magnet). While 'pole shoes' are not explicitly named, the function of gripping and clamping workpieces implies their presence or an equivalent structure.
features.refuted: The quote mentions a supporting casing and magnet-holder, but does not mention pole shoes or workpiece contact surfaces.

features.item: A magnet displaceable along a direction between a gripping position and a release position.
features.quote: The magnet-holder member ( 4 ) can be displaced between an advanced, operative, position, in which the main magnet (M) is designed to grip and clamp a workpiece (L), and a retracted, inoperative, position.
features.note: The reference explicitly states that the magnet-holder member, carrying the main permanent magnet, is displaceable between an advanced (gripping) and a retracted (release) position.
